citation.description: Ticket final comment (timestamp 1788312076099055481) records verbatim greps from CI run 33575422978: `grep -F 'Successfully installed uv 0.12.7'` exit 0 with representative lines including 'Successfully installed uv 0.12.7 from uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz'; `grep -F 'Fetching manifest data'` exit 1; `grep -F 'raw.githubusercontent.com'` exit 1. Codebase confirms action.yml:98 emits `Write-Host "Successfully installed uv $version from $asset"`.

criteria.criterion: A real CI log for the change contains the liveness anchor `Successfully installed uv version <pinned>` AND zero occurrences of `Fetching manifest data`; both greps recorded verbatim on this ticket. The anchor is asserted FIRST.
The installed uv version in that same log still equals the pin in `pyproject.toml`, so the fix does not silently change which uv runs.

Whatever residual network dependency the chosen approach retains is named explicitly in the change description; the change does not claim 'no network dependency' unless the log shows zero external fetches in the install path.
Bug 'setup-uv fetches the version manifest for the artifact URL on every job even when uv is pinned' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
